items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I had a phone call from Mr. Brauer(7) who was the proprietor of the place, asking me, -- he said, 'What happened?'

ctx.x: I still had my Ciro's job going, and I did not intend to go after I found out what was what. Yet, he proposed me.

And he went. He had taken another trumpet player and he went, and the following day I had a phone call from Mr. Brauer(7) who was the proprietor of the place, asking me, -- he said, "What happened?" "Mr. Johnson said that you were ill, and that you would be here in about a week or so, as soon as you're better."
